desc: Derive and verify the equivalence between 400 numbers and squares of integers with exactly two distinct prime factors.
Implement a divisor-sieve-style count of distinct prime factors for every integer up to \(10^6\).
Collect squares of roots with exactly two distinct prime factors, then sort them.
Answer each query using predecessor binary search (`bisect_right`).
Implement buffered stdin/stdout handling suitable for up to \(2 \times 10^5\) queries.
